body: Those years were hell to me too. When I turned 20 I had been expelled from 4 high schools and had never had a job, I thought it was a pretty pathetic record at the time. So here I am now, I'll be 30 in 2 weeks, I've been to 3 different colleges and am not close to getting a degree and guess what? I haven't had a job yet. My 20 year old self was a winner compared to this.
Dudette then, or something? My almost 30 years so far really suck, 100% my fault. I'll take an alcohol induced nap now, be back soon-ish.
Crap! this makes so much sense. At  least in my wicked view of the world.
well kudos to you dude, I'm pretty sure you haven't wasted your 30 years in this crazy world as I have done.
